lines: Online Application for UPSC Pre-examination Coaching (With free food and accomodation)

Applications have been invited online for pre-examination training for the UPSC Civil Services Examination—including free food and accommodation—provided by the Backward Classes Welfare Department for the year 2026-27. The last date to apply has been extended to
The technical issue has been resolved, and applications are now open. However, CBSE and ICSE board candidates are requested to enter their SSLC details manually. Thank you for your cooperation.
